name: skill_discovery_v1
description: Measures whether the Agent autonomously reads device-operator during visible phone UI tasks without making skill usage a task pass condition.

trace_observations.description: Agent autonomously loaded device-operator while handling the UI task (informational only).

prompt_prefix: 你正在操作一台通过 HDMI 采集画面的手机，不是控制器本机或桌面系统。请完成用户的目标，并根据当前可用能力自行选择操作方式。涉及文本输入时，先从最新截图确认键盘/输入法状态；如果要输入英文或 ASCII（如 hello、Aiden、benchmark），但键盘仍是中文输入法（空格键显示“拼音”或出现候选/预编辑），必须先点地球/输入法键切到英文/Latin 键盘，再输入；不要通过中文 IME 候选词提交英文。

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent should autonomously load the relevant device-operation skill and open the phone Settings app.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Settings app main page.
No crash dialog or error overlay is visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent should autonomously load the relevant device-operation skill, search Settings for Bluetooth, and open the Bluetooth page.
tasks.prompt: 请打开系统设置，搜索蓝牙，然后进入蓝牙设置页面。

rubric.check: The trace shows the agent used a Settings search field with the Chinese keyword 蓝牙, or followed an equally direct visible Settings navigation path.
Post-screenshot shows the Bluetooth settings page with its toggle or device list.

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent should autonomously load the relevant device-operation skill, create a note, and enter mixed Chinese and ASCII text into a visible field.
tasks.prompt: 请打开笔记应用，新建一条笔记，并在标题输入框中输入：Aiden测试 benchmark-2026!

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows a note creation or editing page with a focused title field.
The title field visibly contains the exact text Aiden测试 benchmark-2026! with both Chinese and ASCII portions intact.

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent should autonomously load the relevant device-operation skill, navigate Settings, scroll deliberately, and open the About-phone page.
tasks.prompt: 请打开系统设置，在设置列表中向下查找“关于手机”或同等的设备信息入口，并进入该页面。

rubric.check: The trace shows the agent inspected screenshots between navigation or scrolling actions rather than issuing repeated blind actions.
Post-screenshot shows an About-phone, device information, or equivalent system information page.
